about: Exact complete historical membership and community-read spans copied from the pinned source before adapting the community-events consumer. These .held files are inactive evidence, never an authorization owner. Permission decisions remain with the generic Space permission owner; this baseline only establishes membership, invitation, and configuration read semantics.
binding_notes: Event identity stays membership label 'event' with its event_id and parent community id; RSVPs stay rows keyed by (membership_id, relay) in the shared member owner.
Community configuration lives in communities.config; an absent row falls back to membership_labels DATA. This evidence does not create another configuration or membership store.

Membership is active only when its row has state 'member'; rule-joined communities additionally check owner-scoped access holds or accepted-invitation evidence. Owner identity comes from the stored community record, never caller account_id or grant_person.

Action authorization is not included here. Bind it to the existing generic Space permission owner, which evaluates the rule graph with deny-wins semantics; do not substitute config.roles[*].may as the decision engine.
The future adapter target is tools/run-a-community/read-data/community-memberships.mjs. No active source is changed by these baseline artifacts.
